# Promonet

> CRM and tool integrations for small businesses.

Promonet helps small business owners connect their CRM to industry software and the rest of their stack — without hiring a full-time development team. Fixed monthly partnerships or one-off builds, with human support.

## Who it's for
- Small businesses and owners (roughly 5–50 people)
- Teams that need to connect CRM, accounting, booking, and niche tools
- Companies that want fixed pricing instead of open-ended hourly agency work

## Key pages
- [Home](https://promonetconsulting.com/): Connect CRM and business tools for small businesses
- [Connect tools](https://promonetconsulting.com/connect): Search and browse tools we can connect
- [Connect your CRM](https://promonetconsulting.com/connect/crm): CRM → industry software matrix
- [Pricing](https://promonetconsulting.com/pricing): Base £600/mo, Scale-up £1,500/mo, One-off £1,000
- [About](https://promonetconsulting.com/about): Team background and why Promonet exists

## CRMs we commonly connect
Capsule CRM, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Copper, Insightly

## Industry software areas
Mortgage Software, Legal Practice Software, Accounting Software, Consulting Operations Software, Agency Project & Time Software, Healthcare Practice Software, Real Estate Software, Manufacturing & Inventory Software, Recruiting & ATS Software, Creative Services Software, Professional Services Software, Project & Delivery Software
